summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MEBO Payroll System after major refactoring. EventDetailPage successfully split into 4 sub-components (InfoTab, EmployeesTab, DayTab, SummaryTab) with extracted payroll utilities. All backend APIs (26/26) and refactored frontend components working correctly. Role-based permissions maintained after refactoring.
